text.tspan: Landmark Group operates one of the largest retail businesses across Saudi Arabia. Its operations span
physical stores and digital commerce, serving millions of customers every year. Behind these operations is
a technology landscape made up of multiple business systems, all working together to keep the business
The business relies on Oracle Retail Point-of-Sale systems for both B2C and B2B transactions, along with
e-commerce platforms and ERP systems such as OFIN and RMS. These systems support different parts of
the business, while operating under a single group VAT registration with multiple Commercial Registration
When ZATCA introduced Phase 2 of e-invoicing, Landmark Group had more to prepare than just a
compliance solution. Every invoice generated across every business system had to meet regulatory
requirements, while retail operations continued without disruption. The engagement focused on helping
the business understand its existing landscape, identify compliance gaps, and build a roadmap for
